import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import './Blogs.css'; const Blogs = () => { const [blogs, setBlogs] = useState([]); useEffect(() => { // Load blogs from localStorage or initialize with sample data const storedBlogs = localStorage.getItem('blogs'); if (storedBlogs) { setBlogs(JSON.parse(storedBlogs)); } else { const sampleBlogs = [ { id: 1, title: 'Getting Started with Magento 2 Development', excerpt: 'Learn the basics of Magento 2 development and how to build custom modules.', content: `Magento 2 is a powerful e-commerce platform that offers extensive customization capabilities. In this blog post, we'll explore the fundamentals of Magento 2 development. ## Why Magento 2? Magento 2 provides: - Improved performance and scalability - Modern architecture with dependency injection - Enhanced security features - Better mobile responsiveness ## Getting Started To begin developing with Magento 2, you'll need: 1. A local development environment 2. Composer for dependency management 3. Basic knowledge of PHP and object-oriented programming ## Building Custom Modules Custom modules allow you to extend Magento's functionality. Here's a basic structure: \`\`\`php app/code/Vendor/Module/ ├── etc/ │ ├── module.xml │ └── di.xml ├── Controller/ ├── Model/ ├── Block/ └── view/ \`\`\` This is just the beginning of your Magento 2 development journey. Stay tuned for more advanced topics!`, date: '2024-01-15', likes: 0, comments: [] }, { id: 2, title: 'Optimizing E-commerce Performance', excerpt: 'Tips and tricks for improving your online store\'s performance.', content: `Performance is crucial for e-commerce success. Slow loading times can lead to lost sales and poor user experience. ## Key Performance Factors ### 1. Image Optimization - Compress images without quality loss - Use modern formats like WebP - Implement lazy loading ### 2. Caching Strategies - Browser caching - Server-side caching - CDN implementation ### 3. Database Optimization - Query optimization - Index management - Regular maintenance ### 4. Code Minification - Minify CSS and JavaScript - Remove unused code - Use compression ## Tools for Performance Monitoring - Google PageSpeed Insights - GTmetrix - WebPageTest Implementing these strategies can significantly improve your store's performance and user experience.`, date: '2024-02-01', likes: 0, comments: [] }, { id: 3, title: 'React Best Practices', excerpt: 'Essential best practices for building scalable React applications.', content: `React has become one of the most popular JavaScript libraries for building user interfaces. Following best practices ensures maintainable and scalable applications. ## Component Design ### 1. Keep Components Small Break down large components into smaller, reusable pieces. Each component should have a single responsibility. ### 2. Use Functional Components Prefer functional components with hooks over class components for better performance and cleaner code. ### 3. Proper State Management - Use local state for component-specific data - Consider Context API or Redux for global state - Avoid prop drilling with proper state lifting ## Performance Optimization ### 1. Memoization Use React.memo, useMemo, and useCallback to prevent unnecessary re-renders. ### 2. Code Splitting Implement lazy loading for routes and heavy components. ### 3. Optimize Bundle Size - Remove unused dependencies - Use tree shaking - Implement proper import strategies ## Code Quality - Use TypeScript for better type safety - Implement proper error boundaries - Write comprehensive tests - Follow consistent naming conventions Following these practices will help you build robust and maintainable React applications.`, date: '2024-02-15', likes: 0, comments: [] } ]; setBlogs(sampleBlogs); localStorage.setItem('blogs', JSON.stringify(sampleBlogs)); } }, []); return (

My Blogs

{blogs.map(blog => (

{blog.title}

{blog.excerpt}

{new Date(blog.date).toLocaleDateString()}

Read More
))}
); }; export default Blogs;
